svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · four styles for the trusted title bar, drawn by the desktop for every window (apps cannot draw their own chrome) · active, inactive, light
44 px bar, app icon and title left, outline controls right.
Active: raised bar; inactive: bar sinks into the window,
title and controls go muted. Close hover: rose tint.
32 px bar, 46 px wide rectangular buttons flush right,
close turns red on hover over the full bar height.
6 px window corners. Double-click title maximizes.
38 px bar, three 12 px dots left (close, minimize,
maximize), symbols on hover; centered title.
34 px bar with no fill of its own: the window is one
surface; controls sit in a pill; the focused window
gets an accent hairline instead of a darker bar.
One decoration service, four parameter sets
Every style keeps: drag to move, double-click to maximize, resize edges, and the existing keyboard paths.
Snap, maximize and fullscreen animations use the bar height of the chosen style. Native and kernel windows look the same.
Dots never uses the accent for close, so it stays recognizable in every accent; Classic red is fixed for the same reason.
Requires: a decoration choice in the personal appearance record and the desktop drawing chrome from a parameter set (no per-app decorations). Values are illustrative.
